_comment: Gate list, threshold, and a developer-machine __text record (see check_gate.py and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). CI does NOT compare against these numbers: it measures the commit under test and the commit it descends from on one runner and compares those, because the same source builds 0.5-1.6% larger on a macOS runner than here, which trips a 0.5% threshold on its own. These numbers are the reference for a local run. Measured osx-arm64, 2026-09-07. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python3 benchmarks/binary_size/check_gate.py --update Re-recorded 2026-09-07 for the index/page-pruning work, and the previous floor was a month stale on top of that -- most of the apparent growth was not this change. Measured against 5a7e368c, the last commit before it: query_dynvalue +315,520 (+3.3%, the erased lane paying for DynValue's mask slot and RuntimeValue's dtype ladder), query_streaming +14,196 (+0.93%), query_scan +81,804 (+3.1%) and query_cli +76,672 (+2.6%) for the page index, query_join +984, query_streaming_agg +2,368 and query_streaming_agg_fused +388. Everything beyond those numbers predates the change and had accumulated since the 2026-08-05 record.
